subject.title: feat: show a relocating status footer on in-flight channel replies

question: Should messages.statusFooter remain default-on as activity for existing Telegram installations, or require explicit opt-in?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes existing users’ visible messages and edit traffic while adding another global configuration surface; repository policy requires an explicit compatibility and product choice rather than inferring consent from implementation.

options.title: Default off
options.body: Make the footer opt-in so upgrades preserve existing Telegram message appearance and edit behavior.

options.title: Keep activity default
options.body: Accept the upgrade-visible behavior intentionally, document it prominently, and require live Telegram proof under realistic block-streaming and cancellation flows.

recommendation.title: Default off
recommendation.body: Make the footer opt-in so upgrades preserve existing Telegram message appearance and edit behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked proposal, introduced the central reply pipeline, and have established release-level product ownership.
